Volume I is the active textbook foundation for AffineDrift control theory.
Its canonical LaTeX source lives under `articles/The_Geometry_of_Motion/Volume_I/`, with a chapterized Quarto workspace in `articles/tangent-hyperplane-contraction/`.

## Scientific Status

This volume is a living technical manuscript for research and engineering workflows.
It is not presented as peer-reviewed consensus material; readers should treat claims as working hypotheses unless externally verified.

## Source Traceability

- Primary manuscript source: `articles/The_Geometry_of_Motion/Volume_I/`
- Chapter source files: `articles/The_Geometry_of_Motion/Volume_I/chapters/ch0*_*.tex`
- Website chapter mirror: `articles/tangent-hyperplane-contraction/chapters/*.qmd`

## Chapter Titles and Source Alignment

The chapter titles on this page are derived directly from the LaTeX source files in `articles/The_Geometry_of_Motion/Volume_I/chapters/`. The displayed HTML render URLs point to the corresponding Quarto workspace. Chapters are listed in their canonical manuscript order; the Quarto workspace may render them in a different sequence.

## Notebook Workflow

Each chapter has a companion Jupyter notebook in [`notebooks/geometry_of_motion/`](https://github.com/D-sorganization/AffineDrift/tree/main/notebooks/geometry_of_motion/).
Open any notebook directly in Google Colab (no local install required) or view it on GitHub.
